native_syntax: Prefer spoken contemporary English; contractions OK when natural.
register: conversational commercial; avoid academic or greeting-card tone
prosody: Stress natural speech rhythm; chorus lines shorter than verses
rhyme: Perfect, slant, and internal rhyme; meaning over forced end-rhyme
punctuation: Minimal; no emojis; section labels in [Brackets] only
idioms: Earn slang; never stack meme phrases
code_switching: Off unless brief requests mixed language
avoid_patterns: explaining the emotion in the same line that shows it
